findings: The company reports that its Softgel 400 P TWIN floor-standing soft-serve machine achieves a maximum hourly throughput of 30 kg or 400 cones of 75 grams per hour, according to its official product specifications.
The company reports that its Softgel 336 gravity-fed model delivers a maximum hourly throughput of 22.5 kg or 300 cones of 75 grams per hour, according to its technical product documentation.

The company reports that its Softgel 320 countertop gravity-fed soft-serve machine has a maximum hourly throughput of 13.5 kg or 180 cones of 75 grams per hour, according to its published product catalog.

The company reports that the Top Level machine series uses 2.5-litre oversized cylinders paired with direct expansion thermal stability technology to manage maximum production outputs ranging up to 50 kg or 650 servings of 75 grams per hour.

The company reports that the Professional machine series features 2.0-litre direct expansion freezing cylinders with continuous service support to maintain consistent texture under high-demand pressure.
We verified that the company provides detailed self-reported data regarding maximum hourly output quantities and cone capacities across its Softgel product line.

findings: The company reports that its Professional series soft serve machines are equipped with an independent advanced digital control panel featuring a numerical display and icon-based touch buttons to manage mix temperature, overnight conservation, and product consistency.

The company reports that its Top Level series soft serve machines feature a 7-inch smart touchscreen display that provides guided instructions for new staff training and access to production settings.

The company reports that its Top Level series soft serve machines feature Wi-Fi connectivity built to interface with the TELME Cloud system, enabling operators to remotely monitor equipment performance and adjust settings.
The company reports that its TELME Cloud system tracks detailed product sales statistics to identify what frozen desserts are selling and when they are purchased.
We verified that the company's capabilities rest on its Top Level series soft serve equipment, which incorporates a 7-inch touchscreen alongside Wi-Fi telemetry connected to a dedicated cloud system.
